runtime: Rootless Podman; no external network or host mounts; ordinary acceptance user
model: qwen2.5-0.5b-local; genuine streaming llama.cpp inference; include_usage=true supplied by client
redaction: Session UUID replaced; title/workspace redacted and history removed; numeric usage and mtime preserved.
version_basis: JSON has no client version; runtime version is provenance, not per-record version certification.
limitations: Source only keeps session cumulative input/output, not API total or per-call identity/model. No inferred call count or total.
cachedTokens/cacheWriteTokens are initialized to zero; absent and reported-zero API fields are indistinguishable in carrier. Zero cache remains unknown.
totalCost is a client estimate and is not ingested as provider cost.
Only one readonly CLI local-model call; no GUI, cloud, multiple providers, fork/resume or other-version acceptance.
